text:
Google TPU update: New OpenAI and Anthropic orders extend shipment visibility to 2029; v10 lineup overhauled (now Quillfish); MediaTek and Broadcom lead as the top suppliers to watch

Key takeaways from my latest industry survey and research conclusions:

1. Order visibility and shipment plans:
Strong new orders from OpenAI and Anthropic have extended Google TPU shipment visibility to 2029, ahead of Nvidia GPUs and other AI ASICs (mostly 4Q27–2Q28).

(1) From 2028, v9 will become the mainstay of Google’s own compute buildout, so v8-series orders (8t / 8i or their design variants) can be viewed as coming from OpenAI and Anthropic.

(2) Combined 2028–2029 demand: about 12M units for OpenAI (8t, designed by MediaTek) and about 14M for Anthropic (8i, designed by Broadcom), with both growing year over year. OpenAI buys outright, while Anthropic uses a mix of leasing and outright purchases.

(3) Given supply chain constraints, more reasonable TPU shipment estimates for 2027–2029 are 8–9M, 14–15M, and 16–18M units, respectively. The market broadly expects AI capex to peak in 2028, yet this plan shows TPU shipments still growing in 2029, driven by direct orders from AI service leaders OpenAI and Anthropic.

2. v10 lineup and supply chain changes:
v10 has changed from Icefish and Merope / Bladerunner to Quillfish, with mass production expected in 2029. MediaTek has won the design service order.

Google TPU 重點更新：OpenAI 與 Anthropic 新訂單推升出貨能見度至 2029 年、v10 產品線大幅調整 (改為 Quillfish)、聯發科與 Broadcom 為供應商中之領先關注焦點

我最新的產業調查與研究結論：

1. 訂單能見度與出貨規劃：
受惠於 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 強勁新訂單，Google TPU 出貨能見度已達 2029 年，優於 Nvidia GPU 與其他 AI ASIC（多數為 4Q27–2Q28）。

(1) 自 2028 年起，v9 將成 Google 自建算力的主力方案，v8 系列（8t／8i 或其設計變種）訂單可視為來自 OpenAI 與 Anthropic。

(2) 2028–2029 年合計需求數量：OpenAI 約 12M（聯發科設計的 8t），Anthropic 約 14M（Broadcom 設計的 8i），兩者需求均呈逐年成長趨勢。OpenAI 採買斷，Anthropic 則是租賃與買斷都有。

(3) 考量供應鏈限制，2027–2029 年較合理的 TPU 出貨估算分別為 8–9M、14–15M、16–18M。市場普遍預期 AI 資本支出於 2028 年見頂，但此規劃顯示 TPU 在 2029 年仍具出貨成長動能，關鍵在於 AI 服務龍頭 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的直接訂單。

2. v10 產品線與供應鏈調整：
v10 由原先的 Icefish 與 Merope／Bladerunner 改為 Quillfish，預計 2029 年量產，設計服務訂單由聯發科取得。

(1) Icefish 改為 v11，預計 2030 年量產，設計服務訂單同由聯發科取得。Merope 能見度較低，供應商未定，也可能取消。

(2) 聯發科將是 v9（Humufish & Triggerfish）與 v10（Quillfish）的獨家供應商，2027–2029 年占整體 TPU 供應比重分別約 45–50%、50–55%、55–60%。TPU 對其營收與利潤的貢獻預計逐年增加。

(3) 自 v9 起新款 TPU 均採 Intel EMIB-T 先進封裝。考量初期量產能力，預期至 2029 年仍以 v8 系列為 TPU 出貨主力。v8 預期將是聯發科與 Broadcom 未來數年的 TPU 事業獲利成長的主要來源，因長期累積的學習曲線效益明顯，加上雙方負責關鍵零組件與材料採購。

3/ 市場關注度與供應商展望：
近期事件有助提升並維持 Google TPU 的市場關注度，關鍵設計服務商聯發科與 Broadcom 可望成為供應鏈首要焦點。

(1) Nvidia CEO 接班的不確定性，有利 Google 與客戶洽談 2028 年後的長期規劃。OpenAI 與 Anthropic 均為 TPU 關鍵客戶，其 IPO 也有助提升並維持 TPU 關注度，而聯發科與 Broadcom 是市場最容易聯想到的供應商。

(2) 聯發科無疑是未來數年 TPU 的最大贏家，身為 v9 後的獨家設計供應商，加上供應比重與 TPU 出貨成長同時逐年提升，均有利 TPU 事業營收規模擴大。高毛利率的 8t 系列出貨能見度達 2029 年，為關鍵利潤來源。

(3) 因 Broadcom 主導 8i 設計，故毛利率更高於 8t，有利該公司利潤成長。不過，需注意的是，Broadcom 未來數年的營運重點為非 TPU 的 XPU 與 AI 網路晶片訂單，預計最快 2027 年，非 TPU

zh_summary: Sam Altman says it’s “quite terrible” for people to have so much RAM sitting in their own computers.
en_summary: Sam Altman says it’s “quite terrible” for people to have so much RAM sitting in their own computers.
text:
Sam Altman says it’s “quite terrible” for people to have so much RAM sitting in their own computers.

“From a global allocation perspective, actually, it’s quite terrible to have everybody have a bunch of the world’s limited supply of DRAM sitting in their own computer and being used 5% of the time,” the OpenAI CEO said on the Cheeky Pint podcast.

“You want maximum utilization in the cloud if you’re trying to deal with this very supply-constrained environment,” he added.

en_summary: The “overhead supply wall” above SPY is probably not a wall. Nearly half of SPY’s volume since June...
text:
🚨 THE “OVERHEAD SUPPLY WALL” ABOVE SPY IS PROBABLY NOT A WALL.

Nearly half of SPY’s volume since July traded between 761 and 773.

SPY closed Friday at 754.37.

The busiest price was 767, leaving a massive block of supposedly trapped investors above the market.

The conventional argument is simple:

Those investors will sell when SPY returns to breakeven, creating resistance and capping any rally.

It sounds logical.

The data does not support it.

We preregistered the test, built point-in-time volume profiles and studied SPY, QQQ, IWM and DIA back to 2016.

If overhead supply actually suppresses price, larger overhead volume should predict less upside.

It predicted the opposite.

Across the four index ETFs, heavier overhead supply was associated with greater 10-session upside, not less.

The result remained positive across 20, 60 and 120-session volume profiles and in both halves of the sample.

Then we isolated 24 comparable SPY setups.

Over the following 20 sessions:

Average return: +1.80%

Median return: +3.17%

Positive outcomes: 67%

Reached the overhead volume shelf: 67%

But here is the important part.

Comparable SPY pullbacks reached any price the same distance above the market roughly 76% of the time.

The volume shelf was not a special magnet.

It was not a reliable ceiling either.

It was simply another price.

This is not a buy signal. The sample is small, and the outcomes varied widely.

It is the removal of a sell signal.

The current 767 shelf is only 1.7

text:
"After an exhaustive search, NVIDIA names its next CEO: Jensen Huang." I joked about it Thursday. What it takes and where investors fit with some Fable help:

• Shareholders elect directors. Directors pick the CEO. Jensen's ~3.6% is big, not a majority.
• Pressure can flip boards fast: nearly all @OpenAI staff threatened to walk and @sama was back in days. Here, a petition that's gaining steam.
• Time is the ask from @altcap and @GavinSBaker who want a slow search with his return in play.
• Tuesday cuts both ways. The quarter was Jensen's; the $NVDA call is Kress's. Steady may helps board.
• The probes must go his way: @nvidia's review and Congress on Dec. 1 and 3.
• A special meeting takes 15% held a year. @Vanguard_Group and @BlackRock alone top that. Index funds don't typically start fights. Maybe the slide and potential future slide motivates them.
• No-cause director removal takes two-thirds of all shares. A board-backed 2025 fix got ~99% of votes cast and failed.
• Binding route: nominate a 2027 board Feb. 24 to Mar. 26. Vote likely next summer.
• What no letter fixes: a reported relationship with a direct report.

Anything this misses? 
$NVDA

About 186,000 ARMs are set to reset next year, according to data from ICE. The typical borrower’s payment will rise about $645 a month at the first reset.

The hardest hit are people who took out seven-year ARMs in 2020, when rates were near record lows. Their median monthly payment is set to jump 43%, or $1,269, with some going from rates below 3% to closer to 8%.

ARMs make up only about 5% of active mortgages, and today’s versions have more safeguards than those that fueled the 2008 crash.
